language.label: Language
language.hint: First launch follows Windows ({{language}}). Your choice is saved and applies immediately.

motion.label: Motion
motion.hint: “Reduce motion” turns off transitions in this app. “Follow system” respects the Windows animation setting.

rawPaths.label: Show raw paths
rawPaths.hint: Full absolute paths instead of ~ and %LOCALAPPDATA% shorthands. The delete dialog always shows full paths.

refresh.label: Refresh
refresh.manualHint: Scan on start and when you click Refresh (F5).
refresh.watchHint: Rescan shortly after Claude writes to its storage folders (debounced, few watchers).

roots.label: Storage roots
roots.hint: Detected from USERPROFILE, APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA on every scan. They cannot be edited: the app only modifies files inside these roots, and only paths the scanner attributed to a session.
roots.noDesktop: No Claude Desktop claude-code-sessions folder found

cache.label: Scan cache
cache.hint: Speeds up rescans. Clearing it never touches Claude files.

debug.label: Developer / debug mode
debug.hint: Verbose logging, the normalized session JSON in details, and DevTools (F12).

logs.label: Diagnostics
logs.hint: Local paths for troubleshooting. They are only shown here and never sent anywhere.
